confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Colombian price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and could vary by neighbourhood and season. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rate page. I did not open that page directly, and a third-party site showed a slightly different figure for 16 October, so the RBA F11.1 table should be checked for the authoritative value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is other mid-sized Colombian cities in the Andean-valley tourism tier, such as Medellín, with Cali assumed slightly cheaper on accommodation and mid-range dining.
